subject: POC: Bridge credit swap for overnight throughput rehearsal
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex@opsly.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-09T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask: extra credits for overnight throughput rehearsal

Neha —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. We have a dry-run scheduled for next Friday night (06/16) to rehearse the high-throughput path for our POC: synthetic load that will stretch concurrent requests and sequence length to validate tail latency. The engineering team is asking for a short-term credit bridge so they can run a sustained 8-hour window at peak QPS without failing mid-test.

High-level numbers: target 12k RPS (simulated), average payload ~320 tokens, expected total ~55k token-equivalent credits. We're asking for a 72-hour voucher window to cover preflight and a follow-up run if we need a replay.

Can Redwood provision a temporary promo/top-up or voucher for this rehearsal? We'd prefer not to pause the test but can stagger if needed. If you need a runbook or exact traffic curve, attached is our ops plan.

Appreciate a quick yes/no so we can finalize test invites.

—Alex
Senior SRE, Opsly
attachments: opsly_poc_plan.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@opsly.ai>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-09T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: extra credits for overnight throughput rehearsal

Alex — thanks for the plan, looks concise and doable. A couple quick clarifying Qs before I spin up approval:

- Is the 55k number the total token-equivalent across all clients during the 8h window, or per-hour?
- Do you anticipate KV/prefix caching to be warm for this run or will it be a cold-start simulation?
- Do you need the window to be contiguous (8h continuous) or can it be split into two 4h blocks within 72h?

If you can confirm those three, I'll pull a temporary voucher through Sales Ops for a bridge credit. For approvals I need: confirmed run window, point-of-contact for escalation (preferably an oncall email), and the HubSpot deal ID (I have DEAL-9231 on my side).

Assuming approvals are fast, I can have something provisioned within 24 hours. CCing Camila for quota guidance.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
redwood.com

Neha — approved.

Authorized a one-time promo voucher: RWI-OPS-75K (75,000 token-equivalent), valid for 7 days from activation. Jonas — loop for observability tags so we can track token burn across model variants.

Karthik
